question: Q088 - which combination of oxygen deficit, energy demand and geometry changes cellular recovery? (ATP recovery, ion balance, preregistered functional outcome)
purpose: Enumerate PUBLIC MEASURED datasets that constrain inputs/Q088_model.py, and verify one download.
provenance_rule: Every url, license, size and count below was read from the repository API response on 2026-09-26, not from memory. 'source' is what the repository states, 'derivation' is what we computed, 'hypothesis' is what it could mean for the model. UNKNOWN means not established.
admission_criteria: PREREG.md C1-C6; exactly one sample downloaded (PREREG.md 'Download criterion')

admitted.title: Capillary differences with age and fiber type are attenuated by accounting for fiber shape
admitted.size_source: Dryad API storageSize=37741; file digests 33508 + 4233 B
admitted.format: XLSX (one workbook, 2 sheets) + README.md, delivered as a ZIP version package
admitted.n_subjects_source: derived: 23 distinct participant keys (A-Y) in the Sample ID column, both sheets; 46 biopsy samples in sheet CD+CF, paired contralateral legs
admitted.design: human muscle biopsy; Young and Old women; Rested vs Exercised leg; single bout of heavy resistance exercise 5 days before sampling; ~25 fibres averaged per fibre type per sample
admitted.data_modality: measured (immunohistochemistry: MyHC I, laminin, CD31 on cryosections)

constrains.relation: Measured human fibre CSA gives an equivalent-circle radius that bounds the model's assumed radius_m; capillary density and capillary-to-fibre ratio bound the Robin mass-transfer coefficient oxygen_boundary_transfer_m_s and the Piiper & Scheid 1986 capillary:fibre ~2 topology prior.

known_limitations: Cross-sectional; the only time-like axis is Rested vs Exercised sampled 5 days post-bout, so it does NOT resolve a seconds-scale recovery time course.
The two sheets use non-overlapping sample-ID sets for most participants; see RESULTS.md. A naive join on Sample silently drops data.
Fibre morphology, not a per-territory oxygen diffusion radius.

admitted.title: Dataset DESANLIS - occlusion pressure on muscle oxygenation measured by near-infrared spectroscopy
admitted.size_source: Zenodo API file sizes: Dataset_DESANLIS.xlsx 117817 + README 50447
admitted.n_subjects_source: not stated in the Zenodo record metadata; the deposited README (DOCX) was not read because the prereg freezes exactly one download
admitted.design: repeated cuff occlusion on muscle, NIRS measured; tissue oxygen saturation index, HHb, Hb-diff and O2Hb

model_outputs: oxygen reoxygenation timing that T90_F is built on
constrains.relation: Repeated-occlusion muscle oxygenation gives the blood-volume/oxygen-supply side of the boundary condition the model holds fixed at 13.3 kPa (control) and 2 kPa (stress), and the oxygen-recovery time scale that the model's T90_F threshold is compared against.
constrains.constraint_direction: bound and time-scale check on the oxygen boundary, not a fit

load_demo.reason: prereg freezes exactly one download; this is a HEAD/metadata-level verification only

known_limitations: NIRS measures bulk tissue oxygenation, not the dissolved-O2 field in mol/m^3 the model integrates.
Not a PCr/ATP measurement; cannot constrain pcr_rest_mM or atp_capacity_mM_s.
Subject count UNKNOWN from repository metadata.

admitted.title: Data from: Allometry of mitochondrial efficiency is set by metabolic intensity
admitted.n_subjects_source: not human subjects: isolated skeletal muscle mitochondria from 12 mammal species, 6 g to 550 kg
admitted.design: ATP/O coupling efficiency measured at different steady states of phosphorylation; efficiency rises sharply at higher metabolic rate

constrains.relation: The model sets oxygen_cost_mol_o2_mol_atp = 0.20 as an 'assumption consistent with an order-of-magnitude P/O near five; not a direct measurement here'. This deposit is a direct measurement of exactly that efficiency, and shows it is rate-dependent, i.e. a constant value is a modelling choice that the data qualify.
constrains.constraint_direction: direct measurement of an assumed parameter; qualifies the assumption

load_demo.reason: prereg freezes exactly one download; also PDF, not machine-readable

known_limitations: Isolated mitochondria, not intact fibre; does not include diffusion geometry.
PDF only, so values are not machine-readable without manual transcription.

admitted.title: The role of action potential changes in depolarization-induced failure of excitation contraction coupling in mouse skeletal muscle
admitted.n_subjects_source: not human subjects: mouse skeletal muscle fibres, single-fibre intracellular recordings
admitted.design: extracellular K+ raised to depolarise the resting potential; intracellular action potentials and force recorded simultaneously until excitation-contraction coupling fails

constrains.relation: The model's ion term I is a normalised gradient disturbance that a raised-extraK+ experiment manipulates directly: it supplies the measured resting-potential/force relation against which the sign and the steepness of the model's ion disturbance can be checked, and a timescale for restoration after the disturbance is removed.
constrains.constraint_direction: sign and ordering check; NOT a rate constant for the model's lumped ion term

known_limitations: Mouse fibres, and the measured variable is membrane potential, not the model's lumped normalised gradient I.
Does not provide a Na/K-ATPase turnover rate, so it cannot set ion_pump_rate_s numerically.

admitted.title: Data from: Noninvasive technique to evaluate the muscle fiber characteristics using q-space imaging
admitted.n_subjects_source: animal study (in vivo mice); count not stated in the Zenodo record metadata
admitted.design: in vivo q-space MRI of tibialis anterior (fast-twitch) and soleus (slow-twitch) to distinguish fibre characteristics non-invasively

constrains.relation: A second, non-invasive route to a fibre-scale length parameter, covering the fast- and slow-twitch range that a single-fibre-type biopsy cannot.

known_limitations: q-space fibre characteristics are a model-based reconstruction, not a direct diameter measurement.

excluded.title: Emg signals and leg hemodynamic parameters
excluded.reason: 407 MB single file, 8.5x over the 50 MB sample budget. Public, licensed and parameter-relevant, so it is the closest miss: it would need range-request or partial extraction to be usable here.

excluded.title: MCMITO: Near-infrared spectroscopy analysis of skeletal-muscle mitochondrial oxidative capacity
excluded.reason: Repository type is 'software' and the single deposited file is a description document; it contains no measured observations to load.

excluded.title: 31P-MRS reproducibility - datasets and code.
excluded.reason: The most on-topic title found in the screen (31P-MRS reproducibility) but the deposit is analysis code only - Dice_CSI.m, normality_assessment.m, PowerCurves.m, BlandAltmanPlots.m etc. No 31P time series is deposited.

excluded.title: Recovery from 6-month spaceflight at the International Space Station: muscle-related stress into a proinflammatory setting
excluded.reason: Measured and licensed, but the variables are circulating miRNAs, proteasome, mtDNA and cytokines at R+1 and R+15. None maps to a PARAMETER_TABLE row or a named model output, so it is not parameter-addressable for this model.

excluded.title: Myosin cross-bridge kinetics slow at longer muscle lengths during isometric contractions in intact soleus from mice
excluded.reason: Cross-bridge cycling kinetics bound contractile ATP turnover, but atp_capacity_mM_s in the model is a resynthesis capacity, not a turnover rate. Mapping one to the other would be a reinterpretation, not a constraint, so it is excluded rather than stretched.

excluded.title: Layec et al. 2013 / Heskamp et al. 2021 PCr recovery tables (already used as REFERENCE_ANCHORS in the model)
excluded.reason: The values the model already cites as external anchors were not found to be deposited as a licensed machine-readable dataset. The numbers remain literature anchors only; no public file was located to back them.

documented_gaps.status: NOT FOUND in the screened repositories
documented_gaps.detail: No public dataset was found that provides, in one cohort, time-resolved PCr or ATP together with an oxygen/perfusion measure, an ion-balance proxy, a measured fibre radius, and a repeated functional outcome, crossed over low/normal oxygen and low/high work. Zenodo (type=dataset), Dryad and Metabolomics Workbench were screened. The closest title match, Zenodo 19472107 '31P-MRS reproducibility', deposits code only. Metabolomics Workbench muscle studies are LC-MS/lipidomics snapshots, not seconds-scale 31P time courses.
documented_gaps.consequence: Every recovery quantity the model reports (T90_F, V_PCr0, PCr_tau_s, t90_ion) remains a model prediction, not a measured contrast. This is the same gap the model's own prereg names as the required next resolution step.

documented_gaps.detail: Only directional/qualitative public constraints were found (zenodo_5047412_dryad_sqv9s4n49). No public dataset providing a Na/K-ATPase rate constant or a time-resolved ion gradient restoration rate for human muscle was found.

documented_gaps.facet: Geometry at the model's actual scale
documented_gaps.detail: Human fibre CSA (whole-fibre morphology) and mouse q-space estimates were found. No public dataset measuring a per-territory or perifibre diffusion radius with a stated coordinate frame was found, so the model's radius_m remains an assumption with an order-of-magnitude corroboration only.

checks.N1_provenance_null: PASS - Dryad publishes a sha256 per file; the sha256 of both zip members recomputed locally (28cc4cc1f96084f0954be902eef7c0a6943979c238fd6d4c02885e93e3b55dcb for the XLSX, 19669374e179dec57a00d7b83c81c72dfc6e1995aa18f8a697913e5e6a8f4d93 for README.md) match the repository digests exactly.
checks.N2_magnitude_placebo: PASS with a documented mismatch - the measured median equivalent human fibre radius is 31.80 um versus the model's assumed 25 um (ratio 1.272, inside the frozen 20-40 um sweep), so the assumption survives at order-of-magnitude level. The measured median capillary-to-fibre ratio is 1.276 against the Piiper & Scheid 1986 anchor of about 2, i.e. the anchor is roughly 1.6x above this cohort; reported, not rescaled.
checks.N3_no_model_change: PASS - no file under inputs/ was modified; no model output number changed. This task changed no parameter and fitted nothing.
integrity_findings_on_the_sample: README states mm^2 for total tissue area; the deposited column header is um^2. Magnitudes match um^2. README unit reported as wrong; value left unscaled.

SFI recomputed from the deposited CSA and Perimeter columns gives a median 1.374 against a reported median 1.409 (median relative difference -2.03%, range -14.9% to -0.22%), so the three columns are not mutually exact.

The two sheets share almost no sample IDs: 17 IDs appear only in the morphology sheet, 16 only in CD+CF, despite both claiming participant x leg. Per-sample fibre-type counts are 3 for 45 samples, 2 for one and 1 for one. A join on Sample therefore silently loses data; Age/Leg must be used for linkage.
